@note: The wrong answers, as their own sets (Morg, Oct 31, 2026: “all wrong answers are a separate database”). A set’s id is <deck>/<kind>, and a card draws its wrong answers from the set its k names in its deck, or from Morg’s own wr. An entry is {w, from: "<deck>:<i>"}, an answer borrowed from a card of that deck, its meaning line the card’s means, or {w, m}, a wrong answer with a meaning of its own. A borrowed entry shows only while its card plays. An answer joins a set only when Morg or the desk adds it: a new card never joins one by itself, and a card going out stays in every set it’s in. Seeded on Oct 31, 2026 from the kinds as they were, each set holding every answer of its kind’s cards not out, so no fingerprint and no day’s choices moved. build/build.py checks every set, and GAME.md, “The draw and the choices”, has the rules.
